scope: All retained files under data/**/source_exports at both pinned commits. TSV comparisons use literal tabs, preserve multiplicity and ignore RPFM metadata lines. Header changes are not coerced. Other formats receive byte-level comparison only. Added/removed files describe retained export coverage, not proof of game additions/removals. Campaign binary/source checkpoints outside these paths require separate accounting. No claim of semantic completeness or guide factual verification.
